label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_02
text: I hacked your smartphone so I could talk to you.\nHope you don’t mind.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_03
text: Well, as far as you’re concerned, it means I’m\nbasically in control of your phone right now.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_05
text: But never mind that—it’s you I want to talk about.\nI hear you’re a Trainer with serious potential.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_06
text: If that description is accurate, there’s something\nI’d like to ask of you.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_14
text: Nice try, but I know for a fact you’ve already\ncrossed paths with them.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_15
text: Great. I appreciate you being up-front here.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_08
text: Team Star is a group of troublemakers formed by\nsome academy students a while back...[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_09
text: They cause headaches for the school and try to\nbring other students down to their level.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_10
text: And I refuse to sit idly by and let them get away\nwith it![VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_11
text: So I’ve come up with a plan to bring down Team\nStar and force them to disband for good.\c\nI call it...Operation Starfall![VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_12
text: But I’ll need allies to carry out this operation...\nand I’d like you to be one of them.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]

label: legend_0015_cassiopeia_13
text: No need to reply right this second. We can\ndiscuss the details some other time.\c\nTill then, I’ll leave you to it. Bye.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
